maria: addressed comments on PR #5278 — split retry logic into RetryManager, added unit tests + changelog entry. PTAL when you have a moment. also added a smoke script in tools/smoke/retry_smoke.sh
chris: looking now, thanks! quick q: did you keep backoff parameters same?
maria: yes, identical defaults; added a comment and test for backoff jitter. also fixed a flake in kvcache test that popped up.
rowan: lgtm for code, tiny nit on naming but optional. can you add a short note in the changelog about migration impact? otherwise good.
maria: done — changelog updated with migration note and a one-line upgrade step. pushed a squash commit.
ci-bot: CI passed — unit tests (120) ✅, integration smoke ✅. build/5278 status: success.
chris: great. canary window today at 16:00 PST — who can take merge custody? @ops-tim?
ops-tim: I can take merge custody at 16:00. please ping me 10m before and post the smoke command.
maria: pinging for 10m before slot. smoke command: `./tools/smoke/retry_smoke.sh --env staging --count 10` — logs to `/tmp/retry_smoke.log`. If anything fails, fallback to model v1.2 and notify #eng-oncall.
rowan: added a quick third-eye review, nothing blocking. :+1:
ops-tim: noted. I'll merge at the slot and run the smoke. if rollback needed I'll open an emergency revert PR and notify #eng-oncall. :rocket:
